findings.title: Manifest and runmanifest JUnit identity is stale
findings.fact: The immutable input manifest and its byte-identical materialization contain junit_paths=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-repo/7dc61be1-7066-52e0-a5d0-94f90e61430a/scratchpad/orch/workers/agt-P4-D141-cut-controller-0047/evidence/p4-d141c-normal.xml; the runmanifest repeats it. That path is absent. The actual shell command writes --junitxml to the 0055/body-evidence path, which exists with the recorded SHA-256.
findings.effect: A consumer following the manifest field cannot locate the actual XML. The central request, actual command, runmanifest, body log, exit files, and actual XML still bind the genuine 3/3 result.

findings.title: Final packet depends on prior-worker and private raw-artifact lifetime
findings.fact: The manifest selector_manifest still points into 0047, while the 0055 packet has an identical selector copy (SHA-256 59a41669300bdd97fbe7925a36958534abb7a5d7e793dd4ee26fb8c197668ac4). The actual XML, body log, command, runmanifest, central summary, snapshot, ext, and exits remain in private 0055/central-service paths; the result-review source manifest explicitly says raw originals were retained private and not copied into the review.
findings.effect: Current hashes and files are sufficient for this assessment, but the final App receiver has no receiver-owned artifact bundle or explicit retention/expiry fact. Recycling 0047 or 0055 would leave the manifest's historical references or the actual XML undiscoverable even though summary hashes remain.
findings.missing_fact: Whether the orchestrator/App proof receiver guarantees retention of the exact 0055 and central-service paths, or has made a durable receiver-owned copy, is not recorded.

findings.title: Body-process import origins are not directly receipted
findings.fact: The strict launcher preflight checks the pinned Agent/Runtime paths, lock files, schema, profile, composition archive, registry hash, versions, and imports; the actual preflight exit is 0. The actual command then runs with the same pinned PYTHONPATH/environment. Source receipts, central snap, and all four clean checkouts agree on Agent tree 2ebe2ddf5a61f013953ab1e21d51ebaab746e58a and the frozen tuple.
findings.effect: No source-origin mismatch was found. However, the body log is only pytest output and the runmanifest records versions/hashes, not the body process's resolved module __file__ origins. The source binding is therefore established by launcher guards plus exact source comparisons, not by direct body import telemetry.

findings.title: App receiver has no receiver-owned final P4 custody receipt
findings.fact: The App D141 source-binding publication is explicitly source-only/no body, and the 0119 peer handoff says App owns the cumulative P4 verdict while holding it after the custody FAIL. It carries the actual service/JUnit facts in prose, but does not contain a machine-readable receiver-owned binding for the corrected JUnit path and retention state.
findings.effect: The App can distinguish actual 3/3 PASS from cumulative qualification hold only by consuming the cross-worker handoff and private paths; it cannot resolve a canonical receiver-owned JUnit artifact from the current source-binding publication alone.

not_findings: No source-version mismatch: the central Agent snapshot tree, pinned launcher checkout, source before/after/final receipts, and four clean checkouts agree.
